blocks.text: Thermal physics, physics ka aham hissa hai. Yeh heat (garmi), work (kaam), temperature aur energy ki doosri forms (shaklon) ke aapas ke relation (talluq) ko parhta hai. Thermodynamics ke laws (qanoon) batate hain ke kisi system mein energy kaise badalti hai aur system apne aas paas (surroundings) par useful work (faida mand kaam) kaise kar sakta hai. Bohat se atoms ya molecules wala bara system macroscopic system kehlata hai, aur sirf ek atom ya ek molecule wala system microscopic system. Macroscopic system ki properties (khoobiyan) jaise temperature aur pressure poore system ki thermal properties hain; inhein molecules ka zikr kiye baghair dekha aur parha ja sakta hai. Microscopic system ki properties kinetic energy aur momentum jaisi hain. Thermal physics mein hum bohat zyada particles (chhote zarre) se kaam karte hain; un ki number Avogadro's number jitni hoti hai. Yeh particles gases, liquids aur solids ke atoms ya molecules ho sakte hain. Isi soch ko metals mein electrons ki motion (harkat) aur neutron stars ke neutrons tak bhi phailaya ja sakta hai.

Rozmarra zindagi mein kinetic theory of gases ki bohat si applications (istemal) hain, maslan gaariyon ke engines, turbines, pumps, air conditioners, khana tayyar karna (production of food) aur environment (mahol). Inhi alag alag applications ki wajah se thermal physics aham hai.
Thermal physics mein statistical mechanics aur kinetic theory of gases dono ki knowledge (ilm) shamil hai. Thermal physics parhne ke liye in dono ka ilm zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Macroscopic aur microscopic system mein kya farq hai? Har ek ki ek property batayein.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic system mein bohat se atoms ya molecules hote hain; microscopic system sirf ek atom ya ek molecule hai.

rows: Sirf ek atom ya ek molecule
Properties: temperature, pressure (poore system ki thermal properties)

items: Thermal physics: heat, work, temperature aur energy ka relation (talluq).
Macroscopic (T, P) aur microscopic (K.E., momentum) systems.
Is ke liye kinetic theory of gases aur statistical mechanics dono chahiye.
